verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI document at https://cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json. Evidence items were quoted directly from it: its description of the REST endpoints for managing Lambda Cloud resources, and its webhook section. A rendered API reference also exists at docs-api.lambda.ai. The probe's 404s were on docs.lambda.ai paths only, so they don't contradict the spec served on the cloud.lambda.ai domain. Missing for 10: discoverability at conventional docs-domain paths (all probed candidates 404, no llms.txt), first-party docs explicitly pointing users to the spec download, independent hands-on corroboration of using the spec.
